component.name: azure-eventgrid
component.title: Azure Event Grid
component.description: Send events to Azure Event Grid topics.
component.label: cloud,messaging

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of this component start from. Each endpoint gets a copy of it, and the options of the endpoint replace its values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

publisherClient.label: producer
publisherClient.description: To use a custom com.azure.messaging.eventgrid.EventGridPublisherClient for CloudEvents. When it is set or autowired, the topicEndpoint and the credential options are not used.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key of the Event Grid topic, for credentialType ACCESS_KEY. The azureKeyCredential option replaces it, and it is not used when the tokenCredential option is set.

azureKeyCredential.label: security
azureKeyCredential.description: The access key of the Event Grid topic as a com.azure.core.credential.AzureKeyCredential, for credentialType ACCESS_KEY. It replaces the accessKey option, and it is not used when the tokenCredential option is set.

credentialType.label: security
credentialType.description: How the producer authenticates: ACCESS_KEY with the azureKeyCredential or accessKey option, TOKEN_CREDENTIAL with the tokenCredential option, or AZURE_IDENTITY with a DefaultAzureCredential of the Azure Identity library (the tokenCredential option when it is set, else a new one). When tokenCredential is set, an explicit TOKEN_CREDENTIAL or AZURE_IDENTITY is kept, else the type is AZURE_IDENTITY for a DefaultAzureCredential and TOKEN_CREDENTIAL for another credential; when accessKey or azureKeyCredential is set, it is ACCESS_KEY.

tokenCredential.label: security
tokenCredential.description: The com.azure.core.credential.TokenCredential that authenticates the producer with Microsoft Entra ID, such as a DefaultAzureCredential built with a managed identity client id or a tenant id; this instance is used as it is, also with credentialType AZURE_IDENTITY. When it is set, the accessKey and azureKeyCredential options are not used.

CamelAzureEventGridEventType.description: The type of the event, the type attribute of the CloudEvent. If not set, the producer uses Camel.Event.

CamelAzureEventGridSubject.description: The subject of the event, the subject attribute of the CloudEvent. If not set, the producer uses /camel/event.

CamelAzureEventGridEventTime.description: The time when the event happened, the time attribute of the CloudEvent. If not set, the producer uses the current time.

CamelAzureEventGridId.description: The ID of the event, the id attribute of the CloudEvent. If not set, the producer uses a random UUID for each event. For a List body, every event gets this ID.

producerIn.description: The data of the event: a Map or a POJO is serialized to JSON by the Azure SDK, and a number becomes a JSON number. Text that is a JSON object or array is sent as it is, and other text as a JSON string. Bytes, a stream or a file are sent as binary data (data_base64): convert JSON in bytes or a stream to a String to send it as JSON. A List is sent as one event per element, and no body fails

producerOut.description: Unchanged: publishing gives no result, and no header is set

topicEndpoint.description: The endpoint URL of the Event Grid topic that the producer publishes the events to, for example https://mytopic.westeurope-1.eventgrid.azure.net/api/events. The topic must accept the CloudEvents 1.0 schema. Not used when the publisherClient option is set.
